hypothesis: Causal swing-foot acquisition at 0.95 m rather than 0.55 m gives the bounded controller time to center the foot on an incoming ball, improving forward shot quality without knee contamination.
shared_setup: Frozen gate and SONIC, swing-side revalidation true, lateral cap 0.15 m, forward cap 0.08 m, one G1 and ball per process.
measure: Foot-only first contact; 60-frame dx and |dy|/max(dx,0.01); maximum lateral excursion and minimum pelvis z.
diagnostic_gate: No clean foot-contact loss or pelvis below 0.65 m on four; at least two of three poor courses improve dx by >=0.25 m and decrease ratio; good lane 10 remains dx>=1 m and ratio<=0.3; no new >4 m out-of-play. Otherwise reject early acquisition.
